title: Mirror of Fractured Realities
description: A woman in a flowing white gown stands in an ornate, steampunk-style observatory with a cracked glass dome, reaching toward her reflection in a large oval mirror that shows multiple ghostly versions of herself. The floor is covered in shattered glass and water, with gears, celestial instruments, and a cracked globe on a pedestal visible around her as beams of light pierce the decaying interior.
